r_value_map — TOMOGRAPHY spectral_xray op

• Data kinds: images → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.r_value_map(signal, channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0, low: 'int' = 0, high: 'int' = -1, flat=None, min_log: 'float' = 0.02) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import dualxray; dualxray.r_value_map(signal, channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0, low: 'int' = 0, high: 'int' = -1, flat=None, min_log: 'float' = 0.02) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opstomography.get("r_value_map"))

Usage

Return the image of R = L_low / L_high (ratio of low- to high-energy log attenuation).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

単色なら R = μ(E_low)/μ(E_high) で厚みに依らず材質だけで決まる(Z が大きいほど光電効果で低エネルギーの μ が大きく、R が大きい)。多色ではビーム硬化で厚みとともに少し動く —— その動きが「厚い軽元素と薄い重元素」の交絡の源。L_high < min_log の画素(ほぼ素通しで比が雑音だけになる)と信号が 0 以下の画素は NaN(拒否)。
